correctness.rationale: The clipped affine f(x)=max(0,3/5-2x) is monotone decreasing so its iterates have O(n/ε) separated-set counts and zero topological entropy. f² has repelling fixed point 1/5 and a.e. finite capture to the two-cycle 0↔3/5. Exact integration from I0 yields weights ((5-r)/10,1/2,r/10) to cells m-2,m-1,m, all mapped deterministically back to I0 for N≥10. Other states reach this closed class via a positive-measure path; its unique stationary masses are 1/2 and half the three row weights. Independently evaluated exact rational support/weights and all three entropies across N=10..19. This proves persistent three-valued nonconvergence while stationary measures weakly converge to the physical cycle.
residual_risks: Grid N≥10; no assertion of entropy convergence of deterministic dynamical system from a Markov approximation.
